retrieved_via: web text rendering; manually transcribed selected zero-based source rows; generated normalized facts
immutable_content_note: Immutable raw content was unavailable; retrieved master rows are not asserted byte-identical to the history-head revision.
limitations: Legacy ID234, not ID233, grants MP+20 and Heaven. Both effects are preserved.
Cure records use Kind::heal solely for utility routing, have hp=0, and retain their separate lower/all Cure field.
Historical REMOVE_LOWER_HARMS and REMOVE_ALL_HARMS also apply to non-disease harms. The full cure class is retained; profiles without those harms must explicitly record that restriction.
On-defense labels preserve the source defenseExtra location; reaction ordering and affected target require engine validation.
Natural progression probabilities and disease order are engine rules, not inferred from this catalog.
MAGIC, light/dark, probabilistic attacks, other harms, absorption and special reactions are excluded.
Legacy IDs and technical labels are not verified current official IDs or names.
Historical weights are not verified official probabilities; upstream reports distribution uncertainty.
